title: Navigations drawn by a shader
blurb: A four-page site in one canvas. The Navigation API intercepts each link, form, Back and Forward, fetches the new page before the URL changes, and a shader spreads it from the element that was tapped. Both pages are live while it runs.
question: Can the Navigation API drive a canvas transition between two live views: load the new view before the URL changes, and start the shader from the element that was clicked?
result: In Chromium 157 the precommit handler loads the new view as a canvas child before the URL changes, sourceElement gives the shader its origin, and both views take input while the shader blends them. WebGPU is not verified.
